requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-5670-7452--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-5670-7452--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

883-1981-2415-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1308-4365-4826-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

215-5709-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
215-5709-7060.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2092-2757-2974-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Repository Skaab from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Repository Skaab enters, its exploit ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Repository Skaab, untapping the basic Swamp.
Resolve the Repository Skaab ability, sacrificing it.
Repository Skaab's second ability triggers, returning an instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

328-2921-3260-4078.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 10 or greater.
You have at least two opponents, or your devotion to black is at least ten.
328-2921-3260-4078.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat.
328-2921-3260-4078.notes: The additional gained life can be used by Chainer to return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-7110-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Stormchaser's Talent
1618-2440-7110-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Stormchaser's Talent triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
1618-2440-7110-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Stormchaser's Talent. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1806-1887-2060-2511-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vorinclex.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

240-1879-2034-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

57-2751-4460-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-2751-4460-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-3259-5223.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-3259-5223.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3967-4681-5170-7286.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4068-7278.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1579-6798-6972--112.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Visionary Augmenter.
When Visionary Augmenter dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Visionary Augmenter enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
1579-6798-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Visionary Augmenter's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

3532-3761-5078-5901.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3761-5078-5901.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

339-413-677-1251.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

4659-5003-5256-6644.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Treasures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

198-4067-4823-6281.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Timeless Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Timeless Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

4251-4636-5870-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Godo that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
Put the oldest Godo into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Godo token enters the battlefield, its first ability, Gonti's Aether Heart and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Godo trigger, searching your library for an Equipment and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Declare the Godo token as an attacker. The token triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1887-2557-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
1887-2557-3484-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Blazing Sunsteel.

2723-4753.notablePrerequisites:
Blazing Sunsteel and Clever Impersonator attached to an indestructible creature you control.
You have a way to deal damage to the indestructible creature.
2723-4753.description:
Deal damage to the indestructible creature.
Blazing Sunsteel and Clever Impersonator trigger.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to any target.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to the indestructible creature.
Repeat from step 2.

4104-4740.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Your life total is at least 51.
4104-4740.description:
Activate Tezzeret's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, causing Aetherflux Reservoir to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 3.

232-732-1636-4410.notablePrerequisites:
Hermetic Study attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder does not have summoning sickness.
232-732-1636-4410.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {2}{R}.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, holding priority, activate it by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbinder trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
Repeat from step 3.

2279-2287-3560-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2279-2287-3560-4050.description:
Cast Fiery Mantle by paying {1}{R}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When Fiery Mantle enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a 2/2 Pegasus creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Pegasus and the creature that Fiery Mantle is attached to, adding {1}{R}.
Fiery Mantle triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Quintorius triggers, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.

565-3418-3634.description:
Cast Deadly Rollick without paying its mana cost, targeting Venser.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Venser.
Put either Venser into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Venser's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Deadly Rollick to your hand.
Repeat.

1778-2232-3652-5043.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
The Faerie enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
The Faerie enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Memnite from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3132-3750-4050.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block and kill Bladewing.
You have at least six creature cards in your graveyard.
3132-3750-4050.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Bladewing.
Bladewing triggers, creating at least six 2/2 Zombie Knight creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Zombie Knights, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
